scope: Primary upstream code informs hypotheses; master is not proof of the installed revision. Actual Godot4.7.1 runs qualify behavior only within their diagnostic scope.

references.finding: The construction path accepts each material in the serialized surface dictionary; a later material setter updates an existing surface. Moving this assignment is an experimental option, not evidence of a speedup. The actual played material candidate moved the stall into construction and was rejected.

Shader variants are shared by key with a user count, and are released when no materials use them. Retaining the measured canopy material may avoid regenerating that variant after geometry retirement. This causal hypothesis requires an actual-world comparison.
